paper.title_en: Long-wavelength density response and momentum resolution in strange-metal charge spectroscopy
paper.abstract_en: Momentum-resolved electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS) on strange-metal Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+x}$ (Bi-2212) observes a broad charge continuum that is nearly momentum independent over an extended finite-momentum regime, whereas optical spectroscopy determines a metallic local conductivity. We analyze the long-wavelength response function that connects these regimes: the proper homogeneous bulk charge-density polarization. For any homogeneous $U(1)$-conserving metal whose longitudinal matter conductivity remains finite in the $q\to0$ limit at fixed nonzero frequency, the Ward identity gives $χ''_{ρρ}({\bf q},ω)=q^2\operatorname{Re}σ_L({\bf q},ω)/ω$. We then prove that any nonnegative normalized momentum-resolution kernel with a self-similar $q$-scaled profile, uniformly bounded second moment, and tight second-moment tails preserves this $q^2$ asymptotic behavior, changing only the prefactor. Consequently, a nearly local finite-$q$ continuum in Bi-2212, if continuously connected to a regular metallic optical limit of the same proper bulk response, is naturally described by a crossover surface $q_\ast(ω,T)$. The theorem is a constraint on the proper bulk density response, or on a positive $q$-scaled convolution of it; screened loss functions and surface EELS observables require the corresponding electrodynamic conversion before the constraint is applied.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究奇异金属中长波长密度响应与动量分辨率问题，使用Ward恒等式和数学定理推导，理论深度高，方法严谨。
decision.title_zh: 奇异金属电荷谱学中的长波长密度响应与动量分辨率
decision.abstract_zh: 对奇异金属Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+x}$(Bi-2212)进行动量分辨电子能量损失谱(EELS)实验，观察到一个在扩展有限动量范围内几乎与动量无关的宽电荷连续谱，而光学光谱则确定了金属性的局域电导率。我们分析了连接这些区域的长波长响应函数：恰当的均匀体电荷密度极化。对于任何纵向物质电导率在固定非零频率下$q\to0$极限保持有限的齐次$U(1)$守恒金属，Ward恒等式给出$χ''_{ρρ}({\bf q},ω)=q^2\operatorname{Re}σ_L({\bf q},ω)/ω$。然后我们证明，任何具有自相似$q$缩放轮廓、一致有界二阶矩和紧二阶矩尾部的非负归一化动量分辨率核都保持这一$q^2$渐近行为，仅改变前因子。因此，Bi-2212中近局域有限$q$连续谱，如果连续连接到相同恰当体响应的规则金属光学极限，则自然由交叉面$q_\ast(ω,T)$描述。该定理是对恰当体密度响应或其正$q$缩放卷积的约束；在应用约束之前，需对筛选损失函数和表面EELS可观测量进行相应的电动力学转换。
